name: Kyouki
tagline: 287,445 objects, built alone — and verified after a death at 97%.

song.name: I Cant Fix You feat. Crusher-P

facts.note: A solo level — built and verified by one person. Kyouki (狂気) means madness. It was the first level placed on the Demonlist in 2023, and its verification run came after a death at 97%.

theme.mood: Green, blue and violet at full intensity over deep blue. Slabs carved with circuit line work, nested diamonds rimmed in a pink-to-green gradient, segmented discs, and square particles tumbling through everything.

voice.why:
Kyouki is the one that makes no sense to me. It is a solo level. One person built 287,445 objects of it and then verified it themself, and the verification came after dying at 97% first, which I genuinely cannot imagine recovering from.

The name means madness and the decoration agrees. It is stacked so densely that it stops reading as individual objects and turns into pure texture — and somehow it never gets muddy. That blue is the best blue in the game.
